scope: All 40 videos viewed at frames 0/40/80, with additional 0/20/40/60/80 paired BT/DT/ET views for VP002/004/009/015. Sparse frames do not certify motion continuity.
observations: Natural color and recognizable subjects in VP002/004/009 improve over the earlier BT examples, but ruler tearing, distorted lifting tools and incomplete requested processes persist.
VP017 has disappearing rider/bicycle components in sampled frames; VP001 has strongly distorted athlete geometry.
Several prompts substitute a bicycle for unicycle, racket for mallet or sports equipment, boat-like form for oar, or unrelated machinery/tool execution.
VP028/030/040 largely lack the requested visible process in sampled frames; VP007 is highly stylized with simplified colored geometry.
PC alone misses some request failures: VP002 receives PC5 although a convincing bow bend is not evident. SA/Joint and actual motion need separate consideration.
limits: The groups describe observed failures rather than causal attribution. Feature-off, no-C and swapped-reasoning paired controls remain pending. No overall acceptance or claim that native feature modulation fixes visual quality.
